routes.independence: route B has no executable import of route A and no reference to its path; the test parses route B's AST and asserts this. Route A computes the free energy as surprisal plus the divergence to the exact posterior and reads the minimiser off that decomposition; route B evaluates the raw definition KL(q||P0) - E_q[log2 L(o|s)] on every member of the registered family and takes a brute-force argmin. Route A takes exact log2 by int.bit_length, route B by an integer halving loop. Route A decides conditional independence by the cross-product identity, route B by comparing conditional distributions.

registered_scope.probability_class: every registered mass is 0 or an integer power of 1/2, so every entropy, divergence, free energy and expected free energy is an exact rational number of bits
registered_scope.variational_family: all dyadic distributions on the state set with minimum atom 1/16 (DMAX = 4); sizes 3, 9 and 35 on the registered shapes
registered_scope.mean_field_subfamily: the 9 product distributions over the registered factorization of W_CORR
registered_scope.preference_family: all strictly positive dyadic distributions on the outcome set; on a two-outcome space that family has exactly one member, and the package therefore also proves the preference-independence of the ambiguity term algebraically, for every preference distribution whatsoever
registered_scope.rate_distortion_form: cardinality-constrained with codebook cardinality 1; log-free and exactly rational
registered_scope.cpc_grid: the 45 triples of eighths summing to 1, the same grid the AE8 package registers

not_instantiated: Markov blankets of systems outside the registered three-variable roster

prospective_predictions.policy: a refuted prediction is reported with its exact values, a single-stage attribution and the statement actually earned; neither the freeze nor the register is edited after the fact
